notes.title: Balance patch: 1.0.7
notes.content:
[b]Essences:[/b]

- Retreater: Now gives 10 flat range instead of 5.
- Dash Nuke: +100% critical and explosion after a dash.
- Guided: Projectiles now follow the player's direction more accurately.
- Wound: Toned down wound colour.

[b]Difficulties:[/b]

- Reduced range viper spawns on difficulties +0, +1, +2, +3.
- Ghoul assassins start spawning at difficulty +2 instead of +3.

[b]General:[/b]

- Reduced damage dropoff each time a projectile pierces an enemy (projectiles now retain more damage after pierce).
- Slightly increased player invulnerability time after being hit (0.1 to 0.15 seconds).
- New feature: skipping new essences will now increase a random stat. The 'skip'  button will display the upgrade.

notes.title: 1.0.3 balance patch
notes.content:
Crocogame is meant to be a challenging game. However, the enemy damage was too high, especially on lower difficulties, where the players were still figuring out the mechanics.

- reduced base poison and enemy projectile damage.
- reduced base damage on many melee enemies.
- increased ranged viper skill cooldown from 10 to 12 seconds. (ranged viper skill launches 3 projectiles in a cone).

More balance patches will follow if the game is still too hard.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 (Small fix)
notes.content:
Essence chests are balanced to spawn more often on higher difficulties where the player has more available essence slots. Despite that, the essence chest spawn chance on low difficulties was quite low.

Small fix: slightly boosted the chance to spawn essence chests on lower difficulties
